note: Control registry for the synthetic evidence manifest (docs/ASSURANCE-AND-CERTIFICATION.md AS-01..AS-04, AS-06, AS-07, AS-09, AS-10). Owners are roles to assign, not evidence of staffing. A passing test is evidence for review, not certification.

controls.scope: synthetic foundation: control-to-evidence traceability for this repository
controls.requirement: Trace each control to requirement, implementation, test, release and evidence; stale or missing evidence never passes.

controls.scope: synthetic foundation: REST, MCP, worker and database policy for synthetic tasks and proposals
controls.requirement: Least privilege, current membership, revocation and scoped agents across every surface.

controls.scope: synthetic foundation: committed-change audit, independent denial audit, privacy-safe diagnostics, restore
controls.requirement: Protected successful-change and independent denial audit; privacy-safe diagnostics.

controls.scope: synthetic foundation: dependency inventory, SBOM and evidence integrity (no signed release exists)
controls.requirement: Approved changes, reproducible dependency inventory, SBOM/provenance, signed releases and vulnerability remediation.

controls.scope: synthetic foundation: recovery drill, downtime procedure, backup verification and escalation (workstream M; embedded test cluster only, no deployment)
controls.requirement: Timed restore into an isolated target reconciles every tenant table and journal entry and reports measured RTO/RPO against recommended-pending-approval objectives with any gap named; an incomplete backup is detected. Operator readiness lists every unmet obligation (operator profile, 24x7 security escalation, fresh isolated-restore backup verification, demonstrated support claims) and is ready only when none is unmet.

controls.owner: AI governance owner and clinical reviewer (roles to assign)
controls.scope: synthetic: AI use-case registry, tenant switches and the A12 gate (workstream A batch 2; synthetic model only)
controls.requirement: Every AI use case is registered with its approval status; an unregistered or not-approved use case can neither run nor be enabled; use cases are off per tenant until enabled.

controls.owner: AI and domain reviewers (roles to assign)
controls.scope: synthetic: versioned evaluation sets, red-team corpus, thresholds and the regression gate (A-S3 open)
controls.requirement: Versioned synthetic evaluation set per use case with faithfulness, injection, minimization, refusal and availability classes; recorded thresholds; per-case verdicts; under-repeated runs inconclusive; a failing or stale evaluation blocks enabling and running. Not clinical validation.

controls.scope: synthetic: human oversight of agent and AI output (A8-A11)
controls.requirement: An agent cannot approve its own or its sponsor proposals, accept AI drafts or sign; AI output is always a draft accepted only through the owning command by a person; disabling AI leaves ordinary workflows usable.
